name: Memory Append
description: Append structured entries into daily memory Markdown files (memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md). Delegates to the Go binary for locking and formatting.

registryUrl.description: Project registry API base URL for Discord channel/thread → project resolution.

registryToken.description: Key name in registryEnvFile (or OS environment) that holds the registry auth secret. The literal secret value is never stored here.

registryEnvFile.description: Path to .env file containing the registryToken key. Defaults to '.env' in the workspace root.

binaryPath.description: Explicit path to the memory-append Go binary. Overrides sandbox/host defaults.

discordAccountId.description: Discord bot account id for registry resolution. Defaults to ctx.agentAccountId.
